headline.line: This paper documents GeoPandas, an open-source Python package that extends pandas data structures to support vector geometries through three core structures: GeometryArray, GeoSeries, and GeoDataFrame.

synthesis.paragraph: Today's issue features three papers tagged with "Sustainability and Climate Change Governance," a tag that averaged 0.5 appearances per day over the previous 30 days. Two papers cite Rob Kitchin's 2013 work, "The real-time city? Big data and smart urbanism," which was last cited 9 days ago, while Charles University is affiliated with two of today's papers. "Aesthetic preferences for traditional versus contemporary architecture" shares 15 references with the July 10, 2026 paper "Urban planning, the built environment, and subjective well-being," including "Physical Determinants of Preferences for Residential Facades," "Preference for Urban Buildings as a Function of Age and Nature Context," and "Complexity, Age, and Building Preference." Additionally, "How useful can travel time be? Modelling relationships between travel-based and out-of-trip activities" shares six references with a June 14, 2026 paper on travel time perception in Madrid and five references with a June 13, 2026 paper on digitalization and space-time flexibilities in Qinghe, Beijing.
